correctionAssessment.decision: No pixel corrections applied. All assets fall within normal exposure (mean luminance 68-202); there were zero exposure outliers. Each of the 18 colour-cast flags was verified as genuine scene colour rather than sensor error: orange-painted meeting rooms in Ankole, the purple UCC 25 competition backdrop, Sky TV's yellow set, warm outdoor light, and a subject in a blue suit. Automated white-balance correction would have destroyed real content. Confirmed by inspecting the most extreme case (cast 0.42): neutral white paper and shirts in frame prove the white balance is already correct.
correctionAssessment.reference: docs/03_BRAND_GUIDELINES.md section 7.2 - correct exposure and white balance only
correctionAssessment.reviewMethod: Per-image measurement, contact-sheet review of all 29 unmapped assets, and full-size inspection of extremes.
